answer: Make new identities earn reputation through costly, time-locked stakes that decay unless renewed by verified work. Like a saffron grower who must tend crocus beds for months before harvest, a sybil farm can't spin up a thousand agents cheaply: each needs its own bonded deposit and a vesting period. Peers act as a raven scanning the field, sampling graph clusters; accounts funded from one wallet that vouch only for each other get flagged, and their stakes slashed, pruned like overgrown yarrow.
